purpose: Stable multi-view architectural landmarks for camera registration and dimension solving. Definitions are source observations, not Minecraft geometry.
rules: Use stable building corners/joints, not vegetation, shadows, people, parked cars, or temporary objects.
A point is measurement-eligible only after pixel coordinates are independently recorded in at least three usable views.
Depth solving requires points on more than one architectural plane; a single facade homography is insufficient for projecting bays/terrace depth.
Rejected v025/v026 geometry must never be used as a control-point source.
